newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts must hold 114-14 for more upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts must hold 114-14 for more upside.

text.p: September gilts need to hold above key support at 114-14,17 on Friday if they are to have the chance of another run at the 115-05 contract high, technical analysts said.
But the market needs to build a bit more momentum than it has seen in the last few days if that assault is to be successful, they added.

"This market is beginning to look vulnerable unless we can push up very quickly," said Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking. "We need to hold good support at 114-14,17. If we can do that, we can have another run at 115-05."
Ostwald put initial resistance at 114-27,29, highs on July the 9 and 8 respectively.
"If we do fail at these upper levels, I suspect the market will trade down towards the bottom of its range, to test 114-14, ahead of a drift back to 114-02," he said.
Charts show the market hit a daily low of 114-02 on July 10.
"There's not a lot of incentive to pull this market out of its range," said Ostwald.
By 0705 GMT, September gilts were down 3/32 at 114-20.
Richard Adcock, technical research manager at HSBC Futures, agreed the contract would likely trade in a narrow range.

"While the action of the Stochastic indicator is encouraging in that it has turned up, prices remain within the formation with only penetrations of 115-05 completing the pattern and opening the way for a sustainable advance through 116-00," Adcock said in a note for clients.
"Against this picture, we continue to trade the range."
By 0711 GMT, December short sterling was down four basis points at 92.59.
